correctness.rationale: All finite preorders are generated as positive-weight expansions of all poset types; maximal-element order-ideal induction is exhaustive. The standalone pure-stdlib verifier independently generated the exact 16999 posets on eight points, checked all 40877 weighted descriptions, and split shared C2-refinement signatures by complete exact isomorphism search. It reports 35979 preorder isomorphism types, 35977 C2 classes, exactly two exceptional pairs, all singleton weights; each smaller order is rigid. A separate implementation agreed. The C2 equivalence is justified by standard directed binary-relational color-refinement theorem. Finite cutoff only; no extrapolation to higher n.

value.rationale: The class of all finite topological spaces is a natural extension of T0-posets, with 18980 additional non-T0 types at eight points. The sharp first indistinguishability threshold, precise 35979-to-35977 classification, and exclusion of non-T0 exceptions are motivated exact structural facts about expressive limits of two-variable logic. Those non-T0 cases are not covered by the earlier poset-only classification and their rigidity is not immediate from isomorphism enumeration.
